source: make a game where everyone gets a role fighter, giant, and shapeshifter make the game have 12 people for each server shapeshifter can shake into anything so they can hide from fighter and giant. giant has ability to throw cars to eliminate every to win fighter has the ability to fight with super nature powers they have to buy powers in the shop and also make coins laying around the whole map when you pick them up make it have a sound affect and a bag for them the limit for how much coins is 50 for new people who is new to this game give them a tutorial on how to play it and also make it playable so they can explore and walk around

answers.ask: Cars and streets suggest a modern city - is that right, or did you have another setting in mind?
answers.answer: Yes, use a small modern city setting with streets and cars for the giant to throw.

answers.ask: Should the map have real upper levels - rooftops and walkways - or is one ground level enough?
answers.answer: Include real rooftops and a few walkways so shapeshifters have places to hide and players can explore.

config.genre_evidence: The game assigns combat roles—"fighter, giant, and shapeshifter"—where the giant can "throw cars to eliminate every to win" and the fighter uses "super nature powers." The shared map is built around players hunting, hiding from, and eliminating one another. Shapeshifting/exploration are secondary features.

extras.text: Place collectible coins throughout the map, with a 50-coin carrying limit and pickup sound feedback.
Provide a tutorial flow for new players explaining roles, abilities, and controls.

config.evidence: No explicit arena layout, verticality, interiors, connected rooms, or maze/circuit is named; the prompt only says players can "explore and walk around."
config.addendum:
LAYOUT FEATURES for this Action map. Build these as the actual structure of the space rather than as set dressing, keep them visually distinct from one another, and keep the whole layout legible in one view.

SHAPE OF THE SPACE - Flat Arena: A single level floor, free of minor tripping geometry, for the cleanest possible physics.

INCLUDE:
- Ambient Population: The non-hostile characters who inhabit the space — shopkeepers, wandering crowds, ambient animals, a named figure players come to see — and the ground they occupy.
